property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Gets the item identifier associated with the session.

property.name: ItemInstanceToken
property.summary: Gets the catalog-owned item instance token associated with the session.

property.name: PlannedBlockCount
property.summary: Gets the number of destination blocks required by accepted upload ranges.

property.name: CoveredBytes
property.summary: Gets the total length of accepted, non-overlapping segmented ranges.

property.name: LastActivity
property.summary: Gets the last server-observed client activity time, independent of manifest updates.

property.name: ObjectPayload
property.summary: Gets the optional Blob reference for the serialized object payload.
